Strategically making Star Wars Zero Company, ft. Greg Foertsch
Bit Reactor CEO and Star Wars Zero Company creative director Greg Foertsch discusses the development of the latest adventure from the world of Star Wars.
Game Developer Podcast
September 4, 2026
Editor's note: this interview was recorded before it was confirmed that Bit Reactor furloughed approximately 80 percent of employees in advance of the launch of
Star Wars: Zero Company.
For more information, you can read
our coverage of the topic
or review the original reporting on
Game File
.
Star Wars Zero Company
has finally launched, and it's already become a massive hit with fans of Star Wars and turn-based tactical games alike. The games from studio Bit Reactor, which was founded by many former employees of Firaxis who worked on games like
XCOM: Enemy Unknown
and
XCOM 2
.
One of those employees is CEO, co-founder, and creative director Greg Foertsch, who joins us on this week's episode of the Game Developer Podcast to discuss his passion for well-crafted in-game cameras, his perspective on inviting as many team members as possible into the game development process, and his love for the Star Wars character Huyang.

About the Game Developer Podcast
The Game Developer podcast is a bi-weekly podcast chronicling the triumphs, catastrophes, and everything in-between of game development, sharing lessons and strategies fellow developers can use to hone their craft. The Game Developer Podcast is hosted by Bryant Francis, edited by Pierre Landriau, and features music by
Mike Meehan
.
